crossRefs.note: When I, even I Daniel, had seen the vision, I sought to understand it. Then behold, there stood before me something…
This is the Revelation of Jesus Christ, which God gave him to show to his servants the things which must happen soon…
So he came near where I stood; and when he came, I was frightened, and fell on my face; but he said to me, “Understand…
“In the latter time of their kingdom, when the transgressors have come to the full, a king of fierce face, and…
After the sixty-two weeks the Anointed One will be cut off, and will have nothing. The people of the prince who come…
He will make a firm covenant with many for one week. In the middle of the week he will cause the sacrifice and the…
As for both these kings, their hearts will be to do mischief, and they will speak lies at one table; but it won’t…
Some of those who are wise will fall, to refine them, and to purify, and to make them white, even to the time of the…
“The king will do according to his will. He will exalt himself, and magnify himself above every god, and will speak…
I heard the man clothed in linen, who was above the waters of the river, when he held up his right hand and his left…
I heard, but I didn’t understand. Then I said, “My lord, what will be the outcome of these things?”
For the vision is yet for the appointed time, and it hurries toward the end, and won’t prove false. Though it takes…
but in the days of the voice of the seventh angel, when he is about to sound, then the mystery of God is finished, as…
The nations were angry, and your wrath came, as did the time for the dead to be judged, and to give your bondservants…
I saw another great and marvelous sign in the sky: seven angels having the seven last plagues, for in them God’s wrath…
For God has put in their hearts to do what he has in mind, to be of one mind, and to give their kingdom to the beast…

translations.web: He said, “Behold, I will make you know what will be in the latter time of the indignation; for it belongs to the appointed time of the end.
translations.bsb: and said, “Behold, I will make known to you what will happen in the latter time of wrath, because it concerns the appointed time of the end.
translations.kjv: And he said, Behold, I will make thee know what shall be in the last end of the indignation: for at the time appointed the end
translations.asv: And he said, Behold, I will make thee know what shall be in the latter time of the indignation; for it belongeth to the appointed time of the end.
